name: ABS warning
meaning: There is a fault in the anti-lock braking system. Your normal brakes still work, but the wheels can lock up under hard braking.
steps: Drive gently and leave extra stopping distance
Avoid hard braking on wet roads
Get the ABS checked at a garage soon
driveNote: Normal brakes still work, but take more care.

name: Airbag warning
meaning: The airbag system has found a fault. The airbags may not open in a crash.
steps: Keep driving normally, but get it checked soon
Don't try to fix airbag wiring yourself
Make sure nothing is plugged in under the seats
driveNote: The car drives fine, but the airbags may not work.

name: Battery / charging
meaning: The battery is not being charged. The car runs on battery power until it goes flat.
steps: Turn off the A/C, radio and other extras
Drive straight to a garage or a safe place
Don't switch off the engine until you get there
driveNote: Only until the battery runs out, usually a short trip.

name: Brake system
meaning: The handbrake is on, the brake fluid is low, or there is a fault in the brake system.
steps: Check the handbrake is fully released
If the light stays on, stop safely
Don't drive, call for help
driveNote: Your brakes may not stop the car.

name: Check engine
meaning: The engine computer found a problem. If the light is flashing, the problem is serious.
steps: Check the fuel cap is tight
If steady, book a garage visit
If flashing, slow down and stop when safe
driveNote: OK if steady. Stop if it flashes.

name: Engine overheating
meaning: The engine coolant is too hot. Driving on can badly damage the engine.
steps: Pull over safely and turn the engine off
Wait at least 30 min before opening the radiator cap
Check the coolant level and top up if low
driveNote: An overheated engine can be ruined quickly.

name: Door open
meaning: A door, the boot or the bonnet is not fully closed.
steps: Stop when safe
Close every door, the boot and the bonnet
If it stays on, get the door switch checked
driveNote: Close everything first, then carry on.

name: Fog lights on
meaning: Your fog lights are switched on.
steps: Keep them on only when it's hard to see
Turn them off in clear weather
driveNote: Nothing is wrong.

name: Low fuel
meaning: The fuel tank is nearly empty. Most cars have about 40 to 80 km left.
steps: Find the nearest fuel station
Drive smoothly to save fuel
Fill up as soon as you can
driveNote: Only to the nearest fuel station.

name: Oil pressure
meaning: The engine isn't getting enough oil pressure. Moving parts may rub together and wear out fast.
steps: Pull over safely and turn the engine off
Wait 10 min, then check the dipstick
Top up if low, don't restart if the light stays on
driveNote: Driving on can ruin the engine within minutes.

name: Power steering
meaning: There is a fault in the power steering. The steering will feel much heavier.
steps: Hold the wheel firmly
Drive slowly to a garage
Restarting the car sometimes clears it
driveNote: Steering is heavy, drive slowly.

name: Seatbelt reminder
meaning: Someone in the car is not wearing a seatbelt.
steps: Make sure everyone has their seatbelt on
Move heavy bags off the seats
driveNote: Yes, once everyone is buckled up.

name: Traction control
meaning: If it flashes, traction control is working on a slippery road. If it stays on, the system is off or has a fault.
steps: If flashing, ease off the accelerator
If steady, check it's not switched off
Get it checked if it stays on
driveNote: Yes, but take care on wet roads.

name: Tyre pressure
meaning: One or more tyres has low pressure, or there may be a puncture.
steps: Slow down and avoid sharp turns
Check the tyres at the next fuel station
Pump them to the pressure on the driver's door sticker
driveNote: Slowly, to the nearest place with air.

name: Washer fluid low
meaning: The windscreen washer fluid is running low.
steps: Top up with washer fluid or clean water
Don't use dish soap, it can smear
driveNote: Yes, top it up when you can.

name: High beam on
meaning: Your main beam headlights are on.
steps: Switch to low beam when there is oncoming traffic
Switch to low beam behind another car
driveNote: Nothing is wrong.

name: Cruise control on
meaning: Cruise control is switched on and holding your speed.
steps: Press the brake or cancel button to turn it off
driveNote: Nothing is wrong.

name: Glow plug (diesel)
meaning: On a diesel, this shows the engine is warming up. If it flashes while driving, there is an engine fault.
steps: Wait for it to go off before starting
If it flashes while driving, book a garage visit
driveNote: OK once it goes off. Get it checked if it flashes.

name: General warning
meaning: The car has a message for you. It usually shows with another light or a message on the display.
steps: Read the message on the dashboard display
Check the other lights that are on
driveNote: Depends on the message, check it first.

name: Transmission overheating
meaning: The automatic gearbox is too hot. This can damage the gearbox.
steps: Stop safely and put it in Park
Let the engine idle for a few minutes to cool
Get the gearbox oil checked
driveNote: Let it cool down first.
